scanNote:
2-UNITNING TO'RTINCHI BETI (15-bet).

⚠ SKAN OGOHLANTIRISHI: bu bet PDF faylida 16-o'rinda - ya'ni 13 va 14-betlardan OLDIN.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Night and Day' va ko'k yorliqda oq '2'.

CHAP USTUN:
16) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and match the speakers to their jobs. Whose daily routine is not described?' Chapda Speaker 1, Speaker 2, Speaker 3; o'ngda to'rtta kasb: a ballet dancer, a taxi driver, a housewife, a secretary.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Look at the Photo File section and complete Steve's letter to his new pen-friend.'
17) 'Correct the sentences below.' Beshta gap, o'ngda nuqtali joy. 1-gapda 'does' so'zi USTIGA ChIZILGAN va o'ngda ko'k qiya 'do' yozilgan (namuna).
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq "Grammar: Past Simple - 'used to'" sarlavhasi.
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'Use' qutisi ikki band bilan; ikkinchi bandda 'NOT:' so'zidan keyin USTIGA ChIZILGAN noto'g'ri gap.
18) 'Match the present simple forms to the past simple forms. How do we form the past simple?' Ikkita ramkali jadval: chapda (och pushti) appear/travel/be/live/sing/go va was/sang/lived/travelled/went/appeared; o'ngda (och yashil) learn/receive/start/change/have/enjoy va started/had/learnt/enjoyed/changed/received.
19) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts below, as in the example.' Ikkita och ko'k yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi ramka: chapda oltita ibora, o'ngda oltita vaqt ifodasi. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna dialog.

O'NG USTUN:
20) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'The picture shows what Pauline used to be like five years ago. Listen and fill in the missing words, then make sentences, as in the example.' 'THEN' (ko'k) va 'NOW' (ko'k) sarlavhalari. Chapda binafsha fonli RASM: kalta to'q sariq sochli, ko'zoynakli qiz choy stakanini ushlab turibdi; ustida yorliqlar: 'short orange hair', 'glasses', 'brightly coloured T-shirts', 'ripped jeans'. O'ngda qog'oz varaqda qaydlar: 'hair: long, ...'; 'eyes: contact lenses'; 'clothes: smart ...'; 'habits: not smoke any more'. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Agreeing - Disagreeing' sarlavhasi.
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'So - Neither/Nor' qutisi uch band bilan; misollar to'q sariq qiya harflarda.
21) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Fill in the missing words, then listen and check. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.' To'rtta qisqa dialog (A va B), javoblarda tagiga chizilgan iboralar. Ostida to'rtta nuqtali ko'rsatma.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '15'.

exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va so'zlovchilarni kasbi bilan moslang. Kimning kundalik tartibi tasvirlanmagan?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SO'ZLOVChI, TO'RT KASB.

  ⚠ To'rtta kasb bor, lekin uchta
  so'zlovchi - demak BITTA kasb
  ORTIQChA. Savolning ikkinchi qismi
  aynan shuni so'raydi.

  * ⚠ Speaker 1 ning kasbi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Speaker 2 ning kasbi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Speaker 3 ning kasbi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Qaysi kasb ortiqcha - audiodan


KASBLAR:

  a ballet dancer - balet raqqosasi
  a taxi driver   - taksi haydovchisi
  a housewife     - uy bekasi
  a secretary     - kotib


⚠ 'A HOUSEWIFE':

  'house' + 'wife' = uy bekasi.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi: 'housewiVES'
  (-fe → -ves).

  ⚠ Zamonaviy inglizchada 'a homemaker'
  ham ishlatiladi (jinsdan xoli so'z).


⚠ 'A BALLET DANCER':

  ⚠ 'ballet' fransuzcha so'z:
  't' O'QILMAYDI - /ˈbæleɪ/.


⚠ 'WHOSE' va 'WHO'S':

  whose = kimning (egalik)
     'WHOSE daily routine ...?'
  who's = 'who is' yoki 'who has'

  ⚠ Talaffuzi BIR XIL - faqat imlo
  farq qiladi.


⚠ BUNDAY MAShQNI QANDAY BAJARISh:

  Har kasbning KALIT so'zlarini oldindan
  o'ylab qo'ying:
     ballet dancer - rehearsal, stage,
        practise, perform
     taxi driver - passengers, fares,
        traffic, shifts
     housewife - cleaning, cooking,
        the children
     secretary - office, phone calls,
        letters, the boss

  ⚠ Shunda audioda birinchi kalit so'z
  eshitilishi bilan javob topiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA GAP - BEShTA TIPIK XATO.

  ⚠ Kitobda 1-gap NAMUNA sifatida
  to'g'rilangan: 'does' ustiga chizilgan,
  o'ngda 'do' yozilgan.


XATOLARNING TURLARI:

  1) 'does' → 'do'
     Ega 'you' - shuning uchun 'do'.
     ⚠ 'does' faqat he/she/it bilan.

  2) RAVISh NOTO'G'RI JOYDA
     'I drink coffee NEVER' →
     'I NEVER drink coffee'
     ⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY
     FE'LDAN OLDIN turadi (14-bet,
     12-mashq).

  3) ZAMON NOTO'G'RI
     'I cook dinner at the moment' →
     'I AM COOKING dinner at the moment'
     ⚠ 'at the moment' - PRESENT
     CONTINUOUS belgisi.

  4) HOLAT FE'LI CONTINUOUSDA
     'I am not having much free time' →
     'I DON'T HAVE much free time'
     ⚠ 'have' EGALIK ma'nosida
     continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi
     (10-bet, grammatika).

  5) IKKI YoRDAMChI FE'L
     'How often ARE you DO the ironing?'
     → 'How often DO you DO the ironing?'
     ⚠ Bitta gapda 'are' va 'do'
     birga kelmaydi.
     ⚠ Birinchi 'do' - YoRDAMChI,
     ikkinchisi - ASOSIY fe'l.


⚠ 5-GAPDAGI IKKI 'DO':

  'Do you DO the ironing?'
  ⚠ Bu XATO EMAS! Birinchisi
  yordamchi, ikkinchisi asosiy fe'l.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'What do you do?'

items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA: 'does' ustiga chizilgan.

⚠ 'does' faqat he/she/it bilan.
⚠ 'you' bilan - 'do'.

items.textEn: 2  I drink coffee never in the evenings. → I ___ drink coffee in the evenings.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
'I NEVER drink coffee.'

⚠ 14-betdagi 12-mashqning qoidasi.

items.textEn: 3  I cook dinner at the moment. → I ___ dinner at the moment.
items.hintUz: 'at the moment' qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'at the moment' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi.

⚠ 10-betdagi grammatika: aynan hozir bo'layotgan
ish uchun continuous.

items.textEn: 4  I am not having much free time. → I ___ have much free time.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'have' EGALIK ma'nosida CONTINUOUS shaklda
ISHLATILMAYDI.

⚠ Lekin 'have a shower', 'have lunch'
iboralarida continuous MUMKIN.

items.textEn: 5  How often are you do the ironing? → How often ___ you do the ironing?
items.hintUz: Bitta gapda ikki yordamchi fe'l bo'lmaydi
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'are' va 'do' birga kelmaydi.

⚠ To'g'ri gapda IKKI 'do' bor:
birinchisi YoRDAMChI, ikkinchisi ASOSIY fe'l.
Bu XATO EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: We use used to or the past simple to describe past habits and states which don't happen/exist any more. We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi sodir bo'lmaydigan yoki mavjud bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi odat va holatlarni tasvirlash uchun 'used to' yoki past simple ishlatiladi. O'tmishda aniq vaqtda sodir bo'lgan ish uchun past simple ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  1) 'We use USED TO or the PAST SIMPLE
     to describe past habits and states
     which don't happen/exist any more.'

     I worked / used to work as a cleaner.
        (past habit)
     I didn't have / didn't use to have
     long hair.  (state)

  2) 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action
     which happened at a specific time
     in the past.'

     We WENT to the beach last Saturday.
     NOT: We used to go to the beach
          last Saturday.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  ANIQ VAQT ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa
  ('last Saturday', 'in 1999',
  'yesterday') - FAQAT past simple.

  ⚠ 'used to' TAKRORLANGAN odat yoki
  UZOQ DAVOM ETGAN holat uchun.


'USED TO' NING ShAKLLARI:

  Tasdiq:  I used to work.
  Inkor:   I didn't USE to work.
           (⚠ 'used' emas, 'USE'!)
  So'roq:  Did you USE to work?
           (⚠ yana 'USE')

  ⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan
  XATO. 'did' allaqachon o'tgan
  zamonni ko'rsatgan.


⚠ 'USED TO' va 'BE USED TO' -
BUTUNLAY BOShQA:

  'I used to smoke.'
     = ilgari chekardim (endi yo'q)

  'I am used to smoking.'
     = chekishga o'rganib qolganman

  ⚠ Ikkinchisida 'be' bor va keyin
  -ING keladi!


PAST SIMPLE QANDAY YaSALADI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (regular): + -ED
     start → started
     enjoy → enjoyed
     live  → lived   ('e' bor, faqat -D)
     travel → travelled (Britaniyada
        'l' IKKILANADI)
     study → studied (undosh + y → -ied)

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (irregular):
     be    → was/were
     go    → went
     sing  → sang
     have  → had
     learn → learnt (yoki learned)

  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati kitob
  oxirida (128-bet).


⚠ -ED NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /t/  - jarangsizdan keyin: worked,
         watched, finished
  /d/  - jaranglidan keyin: lived,
         enjoyed, travelled
  /id/ - 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin:
         started, needed, wanted

  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning talaffuz mavzusi.

points.en: We use used to or the past simple to describe past habits and states which don't happen/exist any more.
points.uz: Endi sodir bo'lmaydigan odat va holatlarni tasvirlash uchun 'used to' yoki past simple ishlatiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'any more' = endi (inkor gapda).
⚠ 'not ... any more' = boshqa emas.

points.en: I worked / used to work as a cleaner. (past habit)
points.uz: Men farrosh bo'lib ishlaganman / ishlardim. (o'tmishdagi odat)
points.noteUz:
⚠ IKKALASI ham to'g'ri.
⚠ 'to work AS a cleaner' - kasb oldidan 'as'.
⚠ 'a cleaner' = farrosh, tozalovchi.

points.en: I didn't have / didn't use to have long hair. (state)
points.uz: Mening sochim uzun emas edi. (holat)
points.noteUz:
⚠ INKORDA 'didn't USE to' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan XATO.

points.en: We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past.
points.uz: O'tmishda aniq vaqtda sodir bo'lgan ish uchun past simple ishlatiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'specific' = aniq, muayyan.
⚠ Belgi so'zlari: yesterday, last week,
in 1999, two days ago.

points.en: We went to the beach last Saturday. NOT: We used to go to the beach last Saturday.
points.uz: Biz o'tgan shanba plyajga bordik. NOTO'G'RI: Biz o'tgan shanba plyajga borardik.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'last Saturday' - ANIQ VAQT, shuning uchun
FAQAT past simple.

⚠ 'used to' takrorlangan odat uchun:
'We used to go to the beach every Saturday.'

exercises.instructionEn: Match the present simple forms to the past simple forms. How do we form the past simple?
exercises.instructionUz: Present simple shakllarini past simple shakllari bilan moslang. Past simple qanday yasaladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH - IKKI QOIDA.

  ⚠ Kitob ataylab ikki ramkaga
  bo'lgan:

  CHAP RAMKA (och pushti) - ichida
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar ham bor:
     appear → appeared (to'g'ri)
     travel → travelled (to'g'ri)
     be     → was      (NOTO'G'RI)
     live   → lived    (to'g'ri)
     sing   → sang     (NOTO'G'RI)
     go     → went     (NOTO'G'RI)

  O'NG RAMKA (och yashil):
     learn   → learnt   (NOTO'G'RI/to'g'ri)
     receive → received (to'g'ri)
     start   → started  (to'g'ri)
     change  → changed  (to'g'ri)
     have    → had      (NOTO'G'RI)
     enjoy   → enjoyed  (to'g'ri)


⚠ -ED QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  1) Oddiy: start → startED,
     appear → appearED, enjoy → enjoyED

  2) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -D:
     live → liveD, receive → receiveD,
     change → changeD

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IED:
     study → studied, carry → carried

  4) UNLI + Y → oddiy -ED:
     enjoy → enjoyed, play → played

  5) Qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped, plan → planned
     ⚠ Britaniyada 'travel' → 'travelLED'
     (AQShda 'traveled').


⚠ 'LEARNT' va 'LEARNED':

  Britaniyada 'learnt', AQShda
  'learned'. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: burnt/burned,
  dreamt/dreamed, spelt/spelled.


⚠ 'BE' - ENG NOTO'G'RI FE'L:

  I / he / she / it → WAS
  you / we / they   → WERE

  ⚠ Bu YAGONA fe'l bo'lib, o'tgan
  zamonda IKKI shaklga ega.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI fe'l, lekin Britaniyada 'l'
IKKILANADI: travelLED.

⚠ AQShda 'traveled' (bitta 'l').

⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
⚠ 'be' - o'tgan zamonda IKKI shakli bor:
was (I/he/she/it) va were (you/we/they).

⚠ TO'G'RI fe'l. 'E' bilan tugagani uchun
faqat -D qo'shiladi.

⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'l: sing - sang - sung.
⚠ Unli TOVUSh o'zgaradi (i → a → u).

⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'l: go - went - gone.
⚠ 'went' butunlay boshqa so'zdan kelib chiqqan.

⚠ Britaniyada 'learnt', AQShda 'learned'.
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Xuddi shunday: burnt/burned, dreamt/dreamed.

⚠ TO'G'RI fe'l, 'E' bilan tugagani uchun -D.
⚠ Imlo qoidasi: 'C' dan keyin 'EI'.

⚠ TO'G'RI fe'l.
⚠ 'T' bilan tugagani uchun -ED /id/ deb
o'qiladi va QO'ShIMChA BO'G'IN qo'shiladi.

⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'l: have - had - had.
⚠ Hozirgi zamonda 'has', o'tganda 'had' -
hamma shaxs uchun bir xil.

⚠ TO'G'RI fe'l. UNLI + Y, shuning uchun oddiy
-ED ('enjoied' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts below, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Did you read a newspaper last
      Monday?
  SB: No, I didn't. I went swimming.


KO'RSATMALAR:

  Chap ramka (ish):
     read a newspaper
     watch TV
     play tennis
     visit your grandparents
     go swimming
     ring a friend

  O'ng ramka (vaqt):
     last Monday?
     last night?
     last weekend?
     yesterday?
     a week ago?
     this morning?


⚠ PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ:

  DID + ega + FE'L (ODDIY ShAKLDA)

  'DID you READ ...?'
  ⚠ 'Did you read?' - 'read' ODDIY
  shaklda ('did you readED' XATO).

  ⚠ Lekin TALAFFUZ farq qiladi:
  'read' hozirgi zamonda /riːd/,
  o'tganda /red/.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'Yes, I did.' / 'No, I didn't.'
  ⚠ Asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.


⚠ VAQT IFODALARI:

  last Monday   - o'tgan dushanba
  last night    - kecha kechqurun
  last weekend  - o'tgan dam olish kuni
  yesterday     - kecha
  a week ago    - bir hafta oldin
  this morning  - bugun ertalab

  ⚠ 'AGO' - HAR DOIM son bilan va
  gap OXIRIDA: 'two days ago'.
  ⚠ 'before' bilan ADAShTIRMANG.

  ⚠ 'last' oldidan predlog QO'YILMAYDI:
  'ON last Monday' - XATO.


⚠ 'THIS MORNING' - IKKI ZAMON:

  Agar hozir ertalab bo'lsa:
     'Have you read ...?' (present perfect)
  Agar hozir kechqurun bo'lsa:
     'Did you read ...?' (past simple)

  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning mavzusi.


⚠ 'TO RING' = TELEFON QILMOQ:

  ring - rang - rung (NOTO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ 'sing - sang - sung' bilan bir xil
  qolip (18-mashqda 'sing' bor edi).
  ⚠ 'to phone', 'to call' ham bir xil
  ma'noda.

items.question: Did you read a newspaper last Monday?
items.answer: No, I didn't. I went swimming.
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ 'Did you READ' - fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ 'went' - 'go' ning noto'g'ri shakli.

items.question: Did you watch TV last night?
items.answer: Yes, I did. I watched a football match.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'watch TV' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'watched' - to'g'ri fe'l, -ED /t/ deb
o'qiladi.

items.prompt: O'tgan dam olish kunlari tennis o'ynadingmi?
items.question: Did you play tennis last weekend?
items.answer: No, I didn't. I visited my grandparents.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'last weekend' oldidan predlog QO'YILMAYDI.
⚠ 'visited' - -ED /id/ deb o'qiladi ('t' dan
keyin).

items.question: Did you visit your grandparents yesterday?
items.answer: Yes, I did. We had lunch together.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'had' - 'have' ning noto'g'ri shakli.
⚠ 'yesterday' - gap oxirida yoki boshida.

items.question: Did you go swimming a week ago?
items.answer: No, I didn't. I played tennis.

items.question: Did you ring a friend this morning?
items.answer: Yes, I did. I rang my best friend.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'ring - rang - rung' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l.
⚠ 'sing - sang - sung' bilan bir xil qolip.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Polinaning HOZIRGI sochi rangi va kiyimi FAQAT audioda aytiladi - qaydlardagi bo'shliqlarni yozuvsiz to'ldirib bo'lmaydi.
exercises.instructionEn: The picture shows what Pauline used to be like five years ago. Listen and fill in the missing words, then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmda Polina besh yil oldin qanday bo'lgani ko'rsatilgan. Tinglang va yetishmayotgan so'zlarni yozing, so'ng gap tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
'THEN' VA 'NOW' - O'ZGARISh.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Pauline used to have short orange
   hair, but now she's got long brown
   hair.'

  ⚠ Qolip: used to + FE'L, but now +
     PRESENT.


THEN (rasmdagi yorliqlar):
  short orange hair - kalta to'q sariq soch
  glasses - ko'zoynak
  brightly coloured T-shirts - yorqin
     rangli futbolkalar
  ripped jeans - yirtiq jinsi

NOW (qaydlar):
  * ⚠ hair: long, ... (rangi audiodan)
  eyes: contact lenses
  * ⚠ clothes: smart ... (qanaqa - audiodan)
  habits: not smoke any more


⚠ 'USED TO BE LIKE':

  'what Pauline used to BE LIKE'
  = Polina qanday ODAM/QANDAY
    KO'RINIShDA bo'lgan.

  ⚠ 'be like' - 6-betdagi 2-mashqda
  o'rganilgan edi.


⚠ 'GLASSES' va 'CONTACT LENSES':

  glasses - ko'zoynak (HAR DOIM KO'PLIK)
  contact lenses - kontakt linzalar
     ⚠ 'a lens' → 'lenses'


⚠ 'RIPPED JEANS':

  'to rip' = yirtmoq
  → 'ripped' = yirtilgan
  ⚠ 'jeans' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA
  (trousers, shorts kabi).


⚠ 'SMART':

  Britaniyada 'smart' = OZODA, chiroyli
  kiyingan.
  ⚠ AQShda 'smart' = AQLLI.
  ⚠ Britaniyada aqlli - 'clever'.


⚠ 'NOT ... ANY MORE':

  'She doesn't smoke ANY MORE.'
  = U endi chekmaydi.

  ⚠ 'any more' (ikki so'z) - Britaniya;
  'anymore' (bir so'z) - AQSh.


⚠ GAP TUZISh QOLIPI:

  'She used to ... , but now she ... '
  yoki
  'She didn't use to ... , but now
   she ... '

points.en: THEN: short orange hair. NOW: long, ... hair.
points.uz: O'ShA PAYT: kalta to'q sariq soch. HOZIR: uzun, ... soch.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Hozirgi soch RANGI audiodan.

⚠ Namuna gap: 'Pauline used to have short
orange hair, but now she's got long brown hair.'

points.en: THEN: glasses. NOW: contact lenses.
points.uz: O'ShA PAYT: ko'zoynak. HOZIR: kontakt linzalar.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'glasses' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'a lens' → 'lenses'.

⚠ Gap: 'She used to wear glasses, but now
she wears contact lenses.'

points.en: THEN: brightly coloured T-shirts and ripped jeans. NOW: smart ... clothes.
points.uz: O'ShA PAYT: yorqin rangli futbolkalar va yirtiq jinsi. HOZIR: ozoda ... kiyim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Hozirgi kiyimning tavsifi audiodan.

⚠ 'brightly' - RAVISh ('bright' + -ly).
⚠ 'ripped' = yirtilgan.
⚠ Britaniyada 'smart' = OZODA kiyingan.

points.en: NOW habits: she does not smoke any more.
points.uz: HOZIRGI odat: u endi chekmaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'not ... any more' = endi ... emas.

⚠ Gap: 'She used to smoke, but she doesn't
smoke any more.'

points.en: Pauline used to have short orange hair, but now she's got long brown hair.
points.uz: Polinaning sochi kalta va to'q sariq bo'lardi, hozir esa uzun va jigarrang.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA gap.

⚠ Qolip: 'used to' + FE'L, but now + PRESENT.
⚠ "she's got" = 'she has got'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - UCh QOIDA.


1) TASDIQ GAPGA ROZILIK:

   SO + yordamchi fe'l + ega

   A: I always walk to work.
   B: So do I.

   ⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: fe'l EGADAN
   OLDIN. Bu - 'inversion'.
   ⚠ 'So I do' - XATO!


2) INKOR GAPGA ROZILIK:

   NEITHER/NOR + yordamchi fe'l + ega

   A: I don't have cereal for breakfast.
   B: Neither/Nor do I.

   ⚠ 'neither' va 'nor' - bir xil ma'no.
   ⚠ Ular O'ZI INKOR ma'noli, shuning
   uchun fe'l TASDIQ shaklda:
   'Neither do I' ('Neither don't I' XATO).

   ⚠ 'neither' ikki xil o'qiladi:
   /ˈnaɪðə/ (Britaniya) yoki
   /ˈniːðə/ (AQSh).


3) ROZI BO'LMASLIK:

   ega + yordamchi fe'l (ODDIY tartib)

   A: I never drink coffee.
   B: Oh, really? I do.

   A: I often go to the cinema.
   B: I don't.

   ⚠ Bu yerda so'z tartibi ODDIY:
   avval EGA, keyin fe'l.


⚠ QAYSI YoRDAMChI FE'LNI OLISh:

  Gapdagi FE'LGA qarab:

  'I walk ...'        → So do I.
  'I am tired.'       → So am I.
  'I can swim.'       → So can I.
  'I have finished.'  → So have I.
  'I went there.'     → So did I.

  ⚠ Oddiy fe'l bo'lsa 'do/does/did'.


⚠ QISQA JADVAL:

  Tasdiq + rozi     → So + fe'l + ega
  Inkor  + rozi     → Neither/Nor + fe'l + ega
  Tasdiq + rozi emas → ega + fe'l (inkor)
  Inkor  + rozi emas → ega + fe'l (tasdiq)


⚠ 'ME TOO' va 'ME NEITHER':

  So'zlashuv nutqida osonroq varianti:
     'I like pizza.'   - 'Me too.'
     'I don't like it.' - 'Me neither.'

  ⚠ Lekin yozma va rasmiy nutqda
  'So do I' / 'Neither do I' to'g'riroq.

points.en: We use so + auxiliary verb + subject to agree with an affirmative statement. A: I always walk to work. B: So do I.
points.uz: Tasdiq gapga rozilik bildirish uchun 'so' + yordamchi fe'l + ega ishlatiladi. A: Men doim ishga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham.
points.noteUz:
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: fe'l EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ 'So I do' - XATO!

⚠ 'an auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l.

points.en: We use neither/nor + auxiliary verb + subject to agree with a negative statement. A: I don't have cereal for breakfast. B: Neither/Nor do I.
points.uz: Inkor gapga rozilik bildirish uchun 'neither/nor' + yordamchi fe'l + ega ishlatiladi. A: Men nonushtaga bo'tqa yemayman. B: Men ham.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'neither' O'ZI INKOR ma'noli - fe'l TASDIQ
shaklda: 'Neither DO I'.
⚠ 'Neither don't I' - XATO.

⚠ 'cereal' = don mahsulotidan nonushta.

points.en: We use subject + auxiliary verb to disagree with what someone says. A: I never drink coffee. B: Oh, really? I do.
points.uz: Kimnidir gapiga rozi bo'lmaslik uchun ega + yordamchi fe'l ishlatiladi. A: Men hech qachon qahva ichmayman. B: Rostdanmi? Men ichaman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu yerda so'z tartibi ODDIY: avval EGA.

⚠ 'Oh, really?' - hayratni bildiradi va
javobni yumshatadi.

points.en: A: I often go to the cinema. B: I don't.
points.uz: A: Men ko'pincha kinoga boraman. B: Men bormayman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Tasdiqqa rozi bo'lmaslik - INKOR yordamchi
fe'l bilan.

⚠ 'to the cinema' - 'THE' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words, then listen and check. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Keyin juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT DIALOG - TO'RT HOLAT.

  1  TASDIQ + ROZI    → So do I.
  2  INKOR  + ROZI    → Neither/Nor do I.
  3  INKOR  + ROZI EMAS → I do.
  4  TASDIQ + ROZI EMAS → I don't.

  ⚠ Kitob to'rt holatni ham AYNAN
  bir marta beradi - bu ataylab.


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLARDAGI FARQ:

  3: A INKOR gapiradi ('I never make
     my bed'), B esa QILADI → 'I DO.'
  4: A TASDIQ gapiradi ('I often go
     fishing'), B esa QILMAYDI →
     'I DON'T.'

  ⚠ Ya'ni rozi bo'lmaslikda javob
  gapning TESKARISI bo'ladi.


QO'ShIMChA KO'RSATMALAR:

  • walk to school
  • go to the gym in my free time
  • visit friends after school
  • do the housework at weekends

  ⚠ Ular bilan ham to'rt xil dialog
  tuzish mumkin.


⚠ 'DRIVE TO WORK':

  = mashinada ishga bormoq.
  ⚠ 'to drive' - o'zi mashina haydash.
  ⚠ 'go BY car' - shunchaki mashinada
  borish (haydovchi boshqa bo'lishi ham
  mumkin).

lines.speaker: 1  B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQ gapga rozilik → SO + fe'l + ega.
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: 'So DO I'.

lines.speaker: 2  A
lines.en: I never play video games in my free time.
lines.uz: Men bo'sh vaqtimda hech qachon video o'yin o'ynamayman.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'never' INKOR ma'noli - demak bu INKOR gap.

lines.speaker: 2  B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ INKOR gapga rozilik → NEITHER/NOR + fe'l + ega.
⚠ 'Nor do I' ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Fe'l TASDIQ shaklda: 'Neither DO I'.

lines.speaker: 3  A
lines.en: I never make my bed in the morning.
lines.uz: Men ertalab hech qachon to'shagimni yig'maman.

lines.speaker: 3  B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ INKORGA ROZI BO'LMASLIK → TASDIQ yordamchi
fe'l: 'I DO.'

⚠ So'z tartibi ODDIY: avval EGA.

lines.speaker: 4  A
lines.en: I often go fishing at weekends.
lines.uz: Men dam olish kunlari ko'pincha baliq oviga boraman.

lines.speaker: 4  B
lines.uz: Men bormayman. Baliq oviga borishni yomon ko'raman.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQQA ROZI BO'LMASLIK → INKOR yordamchi
fe'l: "I DON'T."

⚠ 'hate' dan keyin -ING: 'hate GOING'.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT KO'RSATMA - TO'RT YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatma bilan to'rt xil javob
  berish mumkin:
     So do I. / Neither do I. /
     I do. / I don't.

  ⚠ Qaysi javob to'g'ri ekani A ning
  gapi TASDIQ yoki INKOR bo'lishiga
  bog'liq.

points.en: A: I always walk to school. B: So do I. / I don't. I go by bus.
points.uz: A: Men doim maktabga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham. / Men bormayman. Avtobusda boraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ TASDIQ gap: rozilik 'So do I', rozi emaslik
"I don't".

⚠ 'walk TO school' - artiklsiz.

points.en: A: I never go to the gym in my free time. B: Neither do I. / I do. I go twice a week.
points.uz: A: Bo'sh vaqtimda hech qachon sport zaliga bormayman. B: Men ham. / Men boraman. Haftada ikki marta boraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ INKOR gap: rozilik 'Neither do I', rozi
emaslik 'I do'.

⚠ 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.

points.en: A: I often visit friends after school. B: So do I. / I don't. I have to do my homework.
points.uz: A: Men ko'pincha darsdan keyin do'stlarimni yo'qlayman. B: Men ham. / Men yo'qlamayman. Uy vazifamni bajarishim kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'after school' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'have to' = majbur bo'lmoq.

points.en: A: I don't do the housework at weekends. B: Neither do I. / I do. I help my mother.
points.uz: A: Men dam olish kunlari uy yumushini qilmayman. B: Men ham. / Men qilaman. Onamga yordam beraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'do the housework' - 'make' EMAS.
⚠ 'at weekends' - Britaniya varianti.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the Photo File section and complete Steve's letter to his new pen-friend.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limiga qarang va Stivning yangi qalamkash do'stiga yozgan xatini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YaNGI QALAMKASh DO'STGA XAT.

  ⚠ Xatning boshi Photo File bo'limida
  (kitob oxirida) berilgan - siz uni
  DAVOM ETTIRASIZ.


XATDA NIMA BO'LIShI KERAK
(unit mavzusiga qarab):

  1) Salomlashuv va tanishtirish
     'Dear ..., Thanks for your letter.
      Let me tell you about myself.'

  2) KUNDALIK TARTIB (unitning asosiy
     mavzusi)
     'I usually get up at ...
      Then I ...
      I go to school from ... till ...'

  3) MAKTAB JADVALI
     'On Mondays I have Maths, Geography
      and History.'

  4) BO'Sh VAQT
     'In my free time I ...
      I often ... but I never ...'

  5) Yakun va savol
     'What about you? Write soon.'

  Best wishes,
  Steve


⚠ QANDAY GRAMMATIKA IShLATILADI:

  • PRESENT SIMPLE - kundalik tartib
  • TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - always,
    usually, often, sometimes, never
  • VAQT PREDLOGLARI - at 7 o'clock,
    in the morning, on Mondays,
    from ... till ...

  ⚠ Ya'ni butun unitning grammatikasi
  shu xatda ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'BEST WISHES' va 'LOVE':

  Best wishes, - do'stlarga, yangi
     tanishlarga
  Love, - juda yaqin odamlarga

  ⚠ Yangi qalamkash do'stga
  'Best wishes' to'g'riroq.

structure.modelEn:
Dear Kim,

Thanks for your letter. Let me tell you about a typical day in my life.
structure.modelUz:
Hurmatli Kim,

Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Hayotimdagi odatiy kun haqida gapirib beray.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Murojaatdan keyin VERGUL.
⚠ 'Let me tell you about ...' - mavzuni
boshlash qolipi.

structure.modelEn: I usually get up at seven o'clock. I have a shower, then I have breakfast with my family. I leave the house at half past seven and walk to school.
structure.modelUz: Odatda soat yettida turaman. Dush qabul qilaman, keyin oilam bilan nonushta qilaman. Yetti yarimda uydan chiqaman va maktabga piyoda boraman.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE + takrorlanish ravishi.
⚠ 'AT seven o'clock' - aniq soat.
⚠ 'half past seven' = 7:30.

structure.modelEn: Lessons start at eight o'clock. On Mondays I have Maths, English and History. My favourite subject is History.
structure.modelUz: Darslar soat sakkizda boshlanadi. Dushanba kunlari matematika, ingliz tili va tarix bor. Sevimli fanim - tarix.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Fan nomlari KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'On MondayS' - ko'plik 'har dushanba'
ma'nosini beradi.

structure.modelEn: I get home at about four o'clock and have lunch. After that, I always do my homework.
structure.modelUz: Taxminan to'rtlarda uyga yetib boraman va tushlik qilaman. Shundan keyin har doim uy vazifamni bajaraman.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'get home' - predlogsiz.
⚠ 'about four o'clock' = to'rtlar chamasi.

structure.modelEn: In my free time I often play football with my friends. I sometimes read books, but I never watch TV in the evening.
structure.modelUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda ko'pincha do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman. Ba'zan kitob o'qiyman, lekin kechqurun hech qachon televizor ko'rmayman.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN.
⚠ 'play football' - artiklsiz.

structure.modelEn:
I have dinner at eight o'clock and go to bed at half past ten. What about you? What is your daily routine like? Write soon.

Best wishes,
Steve
structure.modelUz:
Soat sakkizda kechki ovqat qilaman va o'n yarimda uxlagani yotaman. Sizchi? Kundalik tartibingiz qanday? Tezroq yozing.

Eng ezgu tilaklar bilan,
Stiv
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'What about you?' - suhbatni davom ettirish.
⚠ 'Best wishes,' - do'stlarga va yangi
tanishlarga.
⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

patterns.formula: I used to [fe'l], but now I [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: Pauline used to have short orange hair, but now she's got long brown hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Polinaning sochi kalta va to'q sariq bo'lardi, hozir esa uzun va jigarrang.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'used to' + ODDIY fe'l.
⚠ O'zgarishni ko'rsatishning eng qulay qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: I didn't use to have long hair.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan XATO.

patterns.formula: Did you [fe'l] [vaqt]? - Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Did you read a newspaper last Monday? - No, I didn't.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Did' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: A: I always walk to work. B: So do I.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Men doim ishga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TASDIQ gapga rozilik.
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: 'So DO I'.

patterns.exampleEn: A: I don't have cereal for breakfast. B: Neither do I.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Men nonushtaga bo'tqa yemayman. B: Men ham.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKOR gapga rozilik.
⚠ 'neither' o'zi inkor - fe'l TASDIQ shaklda.

patterns.exampleEn: A: I never make my bed. B: Oh, really? I do.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Men hech qachon to'shagimni yig'maman. B: Rostdanmi? Men yig'aman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ROZI BO'LMASLIK - so'z tartibi ODDIY.
⚠ Javob gapning TESKARISI bo'ladi.
